item.title: Washington Post’s layoffs mark the end of ‘old-school’ sports journalism
item.description: The final blow to traditional sports journalism as we know it came on Wednesday, Feb. 4. The Washington Post eliminated its sports department as part of sweeping layoffs that cut more than 300 jobs between sports and international reporting.
